title: Component pouch
summary: A component pouch is a small, watertight belt pouch that has compartments to hold all the material requirements and other special items you need to cast your techs, except for those components that have a specific…
markdown: A component pouch is a small, watertight belt pouch that has compartments to hold all the material requirements and other special items you need to cast your techs, except for those components that have a specific cost (as indicated in a tech’s description).
